name: advisor
description: Consult an independent coding advisor at planning, recovery, and completion checkpoints.

use_app_settings.title: Use these advisor settings
use_app_settings.description: Use the profiles below. Turn off to use the shared Advisor JSON configuration. Fallback permission and timeouts always come from the shared file.

claude_enabled.title: Claude Code enabled
claude_enabled.description: Allow the working agent to choose this advisor.

claude_model.title: Claude Code model
claude_model.description: Explicit model ID supported by your signed-in CLI account.

claude_effort.title: Claude Code effort
claude_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max; support depends on the model and account.

codex_enabled.title: Codex CLI enabled
codex_enabled.description: Allow the working agent to choose this advisor.

codex_model.title: Codex CLI model
codex_model.description: Explicit model ID supported by your signed-in CLI account.

codex_effort.title: Codex CLI effort
codex_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh, or max; support depends on the model and account.

cursor_enabled.title: Cursor Agent enabled
cursor_enabled.description: Allow the working agent to choose the Cursor Agent CLI. Off until you enable it.

cursor_model.title: Cursor Agent model
cursor_model.description: Catalog model id from agent models. Opus 5.5 High is claude-opus-5-5-high. The id's effort suffix must match cursor_effort.

cursor_effort.title: Cursor Agent effort
cursor_effort.description: Must match the model id suffix. Cursor has no separate effort flag.
